attacks.name: Flyby
steps: After each attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
After all attacks generated by this attack are resolved, Place this character within |!range| 1 of the last character targeted by this attack.

attacks.name: Avenging Angel
steps: After this attack is resolved, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character may Throw it |!movement_small|.
|!wild| |*Stun|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

superPowers.name: Air Lift
superPowers.body: During its Activation, when this character begins a move action within |!range| 2 of another allied character of |!size| 2 or less, it may use this superpower. After this move action is resolved, Place that allied character within |!range| 2 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Hostile Takeover
superPowers.body: During its Activation, when this character begins a move action within |!range| 2 of an enemy character, it may use this superpower. After this move action is resolved, Push the enemy character Toward this character |!movement_small|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.
